notes.title: Release Notes 4/07/2024
notes.notes:
Hey friends! I know its been a while, and I've been working on some new things that I hope will satisfy whoever liked Mythic Prelude's Concept Demo!

Here are the new updates:


 Fixed: In the large room with the flying platforms with bookshelves across from each other, the door to turn back now takes you back to the previous room instead of inadvertently teleporting you to the north end of the room
 Changed: Princess Olinda's name in the introduction as well as one of the Journal entries has been changed to Aurelia. I'm still not even sure why I changed her name to Olinda, I feel Aurelia is more in line with the central motif I still haven't revealed for the Omen.


Figuratively speaking, Simon is still sleeping. He's still going to be a sleepy boy for a while.

Yes, I'm aware that its been nearly three years since this has released on Steam and I missed the anniversary!!
